orders.text:
WPSS No. 1552 of 2020 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta and Ms. Irum Zeba, 
Advocates for the petitioner. 
Ms. Anjali Bhargav, Mr. P.S. Bisht, Addl. 
C.S.C. with Mr. Sushil Vasistha, Standing Consel 
and Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, Brief Holder for 
the State. 
Heard. 
Issue notice to respondent nos. 3 to 12 fixing 
22.02.2021. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Six weeks’ time is granted to learned counsel 
for the respondents to file counter affidavits. 
No ground to grant interim relief to the 
petitioners is made out at this stage. Interim relief 
application (CLMA 10251 of 2020) is, therefore, 
dismissed. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
Mamta 01.12.2020

WPSS No. 1552 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Irum Zeba, Advocate, for the petitioners.
Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder, for the 
State/respondent no.1.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate, for respondent 
nos.3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11 and 12.
Learned counsel for the private respondents seeks 
three weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
Time granted.
List this matter after three weeks.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 22.02.2021
Nitesh
